quote: On February 21, 2024, Intel Corporation ("Intel") issued $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.000% Senior Notes due 2031 (the "2031 Notes"), $900,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.150% Senior Notes due 2034 (the "2034 Notes") and $1,150,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.600% Senior Notes due 2054 (the "2054 Notes" and, together with the 2031 Notes and the 2034 Notes, the "Notes") pursuant to the terms of an underwriting agreement dated February 15, 2024 (the "Underwriting Agreement") among Intel and BofA Securities, Inc., Citigroup Global Markets Inc., Goldman Sachs & Co.
